LESSON: PILLARS OF

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: outcomes DEVOTIONAL
Topic 5.1: Pillars of

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Pillars of. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Why do we pray?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Demonstrate the correct postures for validity of Swalah
2. Appreciate swalah as a form of thanking Allah Core-Competences to be developed: Communication and collaboration Learning to learn Critical thinking and problem solving Citizenship-group work

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Demonstrate the correct postures for validity of Swalah
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to demonstrate the correct postures for validity of Swalah. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. Appreciate swalah as a form of thanking Allah Core-Competences to be developed: Communication and collaboration Learning to learn Critical thinking and problem solving Citizenship-group work
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate swalah as a form of thanking Allah Core-Competences to be developed: Communication and collaboration Learning to learn Critical thinking and problem solving Citizenship-group work. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Greet others politely using Islamic greetings you have learned.

Example 2: Keep yourself clean before prayer, just as you wash hands before eating.

Example 3: Share with a friend one good manner you practised today.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Pillars of.
2. Explain Pillars of to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Pillars of.
4. Show that you can: Demonstrate the correct postures for validity of Swalah
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Pillars of. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why do we pray?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. Demonstrate the correct postures for validity of Swalah
2. Appreciate swalah as a form of thanking Allah Core-Competences to be developed: Communication and collaboration Learning to learn Critical thinking and problem solving Citizenship-group work

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
